_note: The food plan, one block per mission day of the thirteen: "1": [ { "slot": "LUNCH", "recipe": "lentil-tomato-stew" } ]. Ships empty — each day's Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner are chosen on mission control's Habitat tab from the recipe book (content/recipes.json) or filled in by hand, and saved here. Slots are BREAKFAST, LUNCH and DINNER, then the meals added on the desk with + Add a meal: EXTRA1, EXTRA2, … (shown as Extra meal, Extra meal 2, …), each of which may name its hours as "served": "16:00-17:00"; RATION (Other) is the slot older files used and is read as an added meal. A meal written by hand takes name, components (one line per item, \n between them), kcal, water (litres), prep (minutes), energy (watt hours), and optionally nutrients, co2e_kg and water_footprint_l; a meal naming a recipe takes whatever it does not say from the book. The power a meal used is NOT this file's energy figure but the kitchen's energy meter, read between the meal's hours — breakfast 06:00–09:00, lunch 09:00–14:00, dinner 15:00–22:00 (content/home-assistant.json, meals), an added meal between its served hours — wherever the meter has a reading for them; the energy figure stands in only where it has none. Everything here is shown publicly and totalled per day.
